audit.deathCategoryContract: all deaths exactly one exclusive #983 category; pure raw incidence denominator is all runs

modeledSystems: production map generation and encounter sequence
production equipment, affix, curse, inventory, recovery, and floor transition rules
omittedSystems: actual player checkpoint distribution beyond observed prefix

interpretation.checkpointExperiment: measurement layer that removes shallow exploration censor; not a player B21/B30 reach-rate claim or typical checkpoint-state claim
interpretation.syntheticRule: failed bounded continuation keeps the preceding state and applies only production 15% HP floor-transition recovery; no MP, stats, gear, affix, inventory, or combat-power correction

finalAnalysis.pureRawDepthConclusion: not monotonic; deep normal damage rises while pure-raw incidence remains material but varies by checkpoint
finalAnalysis.conservativePenaltyB21Plus: present at B21, largely converged by B25/B30
finalAnalysis.ordinaryDamageCause: mixed: MP/action choice changes attacks and exposure, while depth-scaled normal damage remains material
finalAnalysis.deepRawWall: strong for survival/death incidence; pure raw is a major but non-exclusive death cause
